paragraphs.text: 1. WITH offerings of our own we choose thee, Agni, as Invoking Priest,
For sacrifice with trimmed grass,-at your glad carouse-piercing and brightly shining. Thou art waxing great.
paragraphs.original: यज्ञाय स्तीर्णबर्हिषे वि वो मदे शीरं पावकशोचिषं विवक्षसे
paragraphs.translit: yajñāya stīrṇabarhiṣe vi vo made śīraṃ pāvakaśociṣaṃ vivakṣase

paragraphs.text: 2. The wealthy ones adorn thee, they who bring us horses as their gift:
The sprinkling ladle, Agni,-at your glad carouse -and glowing offering taste thee. Thou art waxing great.
paragraphs.original: वेति त्वामुपसेचनी वि वो मद ऋजीतिरग्न आहुतिर्विवक्षसे
paragraphs.translit: veti tvāmupasecanī vi vo mada ṛjītiragna āhutirvivakṣase

paragraphs.text: 3. The holy statutes rest by thee, as 'twere with ladles that o'erflow.
Black and white-gleaming colours,-at your glad carouse-all glories thou assumest. Thou art waxing great.
paragraphs.original: कृष्णा रूपाण्यर्जुना वि वो मदे विश्वा अधि श्रियो धिषे विवक्षसे
paragraphs.translit: kṛṣṇā rūpāṇyarjunā vi vo made viśvā adhi śriyo dhiṣe vivakṣase

paragraphs.text: 4. O Agni, what thou deemest wealth, Victorious and Immortal One!
Bring thou to give us vigour,-at your glad carouse -splendid at sacrifices. Thou art waxing great.
paragraphs.original: तमा नो वाजसातये वि वो मदे यज्ञेषु चित्रमा भरा विवक्षसे
paragraphs.translit: tamā no vājasātaye vi vo made yajñeṣu citramā bharā vivakṣase

paragraphs.text: 5. Skilled in all lore is Agni, he whom erst Atharvan brought to life.
He was Vivasvan's envoy, at your glad carouse-the well-loved friend of Yama, Thou art waxing great.
paragraphs.original: भुवद्दूतो विवस्वतो वि वो मदे प्रियो यमस्य काम्यो विवक्षसे
paragraphs.translit: bhuvaddūto vivasvato vi vo made priyo yamasya kāmyo vivakṣase

paragraphs.text: 6. At sacrifices they adore thee, Agni, when the rite proceeds.
All fair and lovely treasures-at your glad carouse-thou givest him who offers. Thou art waxing great.
paragraphs.original: त्वं वसूनि काम्या वि वो मदे विश्वा दधासि दाशुषे विवक्षसे
paragraphs.translit: tvaṃ vasūni kāmyā vi vo made viśvā dadhāsi dāśuṣe vivakṣase

paragraphs.text: 7. Men, Agni, have established thee as welcome Priest at holy rites,
Thee whose face shines with butter,-at your glad carouse-bright, with eyes most observant. Thou art waxing great.
paragraphs.original: घृतप्रतीकं मनुषो वि वो मदे शुक्रं चेतिष्ठमक्षभिर्विवक्षसे
paragraphs.translit: ghṛtapratīkaṃ manuṣo vi vo made śukraṃ cetiṣṭhamakṣabhirvivakṣase

paragraphs.text: 8. Wide and aloft thou spreadest thee, O Agni, with thy brilliant flame.
A Bull art thou when bellowing,-at your glad carouse-thou dost impregn the Sisters. Thou art waxing great.
paragraphs.original: अभिक्रन्दन्वृषायसे वि वो मदे गर्भं दधासि जामिषु विवक्षसे
paragraphs.translit: abhikrandanvṛṣāyase vi vo made garbhaṃ dadhāsi jāmiṣu vivakṣase
